verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party Batch API docs say you can submit workloads as an asynchronous batch of requests at 50% lower cost, with a 24-hour to 7-day processing window and no impact on standard rate limits. That covers both the async submission and the documented discount. The billing FAQ lists Batch Processing as a paid-tier benefit, so it is unavailable on the free tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of batch jobs and the discount, and detail on the job lifecycle (input file format, status polling, result retrieval).
